text: Yes, the property lost tree cover in 2024. Earth observation data confirmed a 0.7-hectare loss event in 2023, with an additional 0.4 hectares of smaller patches lost in 2023 and 0.7 hectares in 2024. While the 2024 loss fell below the 0.5-hectare threshold for classification as an event, it was still detected as canopy reduction. The total loss since the 2020 baseline amounts to at least 1.8 hectares (0.7 ha in 2023 + 0.4 ha + 0.7 ha in 2024). The change was corroborated by multiple independent datasets.
